# awscc_guardduty_custom_detection_rule_association (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::GuardDuty::CustomDetectionRuleAssociation. Associates a GuardDuty custom detection rule with the caller's account, enabling the rule in either LIVE or DRY_RUN mode.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) Whether the rule runs in LIVE mode (generates findings) or DRY_RUN mode (evaluates without generating findings).
- `rule_id` (String) The catalog identifier of the custom detection rule to associate.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags applied to the association. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) The AWS account ID the association applies to.
- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the association.
- `association_id` (String) The service-generated unique identifier of the association.
- `created_at` (String) The time the association was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) The time the association was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_guardduty_custom_detection_rule_association.example
  identity = {
    rule_id        = "rule_id"
    association_id = "association_id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `association_id` (String) The service-generated unique identifier of the association
- `rule_id` (String) The catalog identifier of the custom detection rule to associate

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_guardduty_custom_detection_rule_association.example
  id = "rule_id|association_id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_guardduty_custom_detection_rule_association.example "rule_id|association_id"
```
